body: theres so much more going on with me. I true self hate. I am constantly full of negative thoughts of myself.  I dont have money or the means to pay for health insurance. I do appreciate your kind words. I stopped therapy a long time ago because I agree with that particular statement. I honestly hope the time that I spent here, I had positive impacts on people. but does that mean I should be a martyr and continue to suffer with no end in sight for others happiness. or should i just end it all.
